data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'εγχθω' (egchtho), meaning 'to bestow, to offer.' The name Beghtol can be interpreted as 'God's bounty' or 'God's gift.'. The name Beghtol carries the meaning “God's bounty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beghtol usually hope their child will grow to embody god's bounty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
